using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using Garnet.common;
using Garnet.server;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Tsavorite.core;
using Xunit;

public class MultiDatabaseManagerTests
{
    private class MockStoreWrapper : StoreWrapper
    {
        public MockStoreWrapper(DatabaseCreatorDelegate createDatabaseDelegate) : base(createDatabaseDelegate, null!, null!)
        {
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsError_WhenTryGetSavedDatabaseIdsThrows()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MultiDatabaseManager>>();
        var serverOptionsMock = new Mock<ServerOptions>();
        serverOptionsMock.Setup(o => o.FailOnRecoveryError).Returns(false);

        var storeWrapper = new Mock<MockStoreWrapper>(MockBehavior.Strict, new DatabaseCreatorDelegate((id) => throw new InvalidOperationException("not called")));
        storeWrapper.Setup(s => s.serverOptions).Returns(serverOptionsMock.Object);
        storeWrapper.Setup(s => s.loggerFactory).Returns(Mock.Of<ILoggerFactory>(lf => lf.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>()) == loggerMock.Object));

        var manager = new MultiDatabaseManager(storeWrapper.Object, false);

        // Mock the protected method using reflection
        var dbIdsField = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetField("databases", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
        dbIdsField.SetValue(manager, new ExpandableMap<GarnetDatabase>(1, 0, 0));

        // Act & Assert
        var ex = Assert.Throws<GarnetException>(() => manager.RecoverCheckpoint());
        loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.LogInformation(
                It.Is<Exception>(e => e.Message.Contains("Error during recovery of database ids")),
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Error during recovery of database ids")),
                It.IsAny<object[]>()
            ),
            Times.Once
        );
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsNoHybridLogException_WhenTsavoriteNoHybridLogExceptionThrown()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MultiDatabaseManager>>();
        var serverOptionsMock = new Mock<ServerOptions>();
        serverOptionsMock.Setup(o => o.FailOnRecoveryError).Returns(false);

        var storeWrapper = new Mock<MockStoreWrapper>(MockBehavior.Strict, new DatabaseCreatorDelegate((id) => 
        {
            var db = new Mock<GarnetDatabase>(MockBehavior.Strict, null!, null!, null!, null!, null!);
            db.Setup(d => d.ObjectStore).Returns((Tsavorite.core.ITsavoriteObjectStore)null);
            return db.Object;
        }));
        storeWrapper.Setup(s => s.serverOptions).Returns(serverOptionsMock.Object);
        storeWrapper.Setup(s => s.loggerFactory).Returns(Mock.Of<ILoggerFactory>(lf => lf.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>()) == loggerMock.Object));

        var manager = new MultiDatabaseManager(storeWrapper.Object, false);
        var dbIdsField = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetField("databases", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
        dbIdsField.SetValue(manager, new ExpandableMap<GarnetDatabase>(1, 0, 0));

        // Mock TryGetSavedDatabaseIds to return one dbId
        var method = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetMethod("TryGetSavedDatabaseIds", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
        method.Invoke(manager, new object[] { "", "", null });

        // Act & Assert
        manager.RecoverCheckpoint();
        loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.LogInformation(
                It.Is<TsavoriteNoHybridLogException>(e => true),
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("No Hybrid Log found for recovery")),
                It.Is<long>(0),
                It.Is<long>(0)
            ),
            Times.Once
        );
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsGenericRecoveryError_WhenGenericExceptionThrown()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MultiDatabaseManager>>();
        var serverOptionsMock = new Mock<ServerOptions>();
        serverOptionsMock.Setup(o => o.FailOnRecoveryError).Returns(false);

        var storeWrapper = new Mock<MockStoreWrapper>(MockBehavior.Strict, new DatabaseCreatorDelegate((id) => 
        {
            var db = new Mock<GarnetDatabase>();
            db.Setup(d => d.ObjectStore).Returns((Tsavorite.core.ITsavoriteObjectStore)null);
            return db.Object;
        }));
        storeWrapper.Setup(s => s.serverOptions).Returns(serverOptionsMock.Object);
        storeWrapper.Setup(s => s.loggerFactory).Returns(Mock.Of<ILoggerFactory>(lf => lf.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>()) == loggerMock.Object));

        var manager = new MultiDatabaseManager(storeWrapper.Object, false);
        var dbIdsField = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetField("databases", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
        dbIdsField.SetValue(manager, new ExpandableMap<GarnetDatabase>(1, 0, 0));

        // Mock TryGetSavedDatabaseIds to return one dbId
        var method = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetMethod("TryGetSavedDatabaseIds", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
        method.Invoke(manager, new object[] { "", "", null });

        // Act & Assert
        manager.RecoverCheckpoint();
        loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.LogInformation(
                It.Is<Exception>(e => !(e is TsavoriteNoHybridLogException)),
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Error during recovery of store")),
                It.Is<long>(0),
                It.Is<long>(0)
            ),
            Times.Once

    [Fact]
    public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsVersionMismatch_WhenStoreVersionsDiffer()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MultiDatabaseManager>>();
        var serverOptionsMock = new Mock<ServerOptions>();
        serverOptionsMock.Setup(o => o.FailOnRecoveryError).Returns(false);

        var storeWrapper = new Mock<MockStoreWrapper>(MockBehavior.Strict, new DatabaseCreatorDelegate((id) => 
        {
            var db = new Mock<GarnetDatabase>();
            db.Setup(d => d.ObjectStore).Returns(Mock.Of<Tsavorite.core.ITsavoriteObjectStore>());
            return db.Object;
        }));
        storeWrapper.Setup(s => s.serverOptions).Returns(serverOptionsMock.Object);
        storeWrapper.Setup(s => s.loggerFactory).Returns(Mock.Of<ILoggerFactory>(lf => lf.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>()) == loggerMock.Object));

        var manager = new MultiDatabaseManager(storeWrapper.Object, false);
        var dbIdsField = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetField("databases", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
        dbIdsField.SetValue(manager, new ExpandableMap<GarnetDatabase>(1, 0, 0));

        // Mock TryGetSavedDatabaseIds to return one dbId
        var method = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetMethod("TryGetSavedDatabaseIds", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
        method.Invoke(manager, new object[] { "", "", null });

        // Mock RecoverDatabaseCheckpoint to set different versions
        var recoverMethod = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetMethod("RecoverDatabaseCheckpoint", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
        // This would need actual implementation mocking, but for LogInformation verification it should trigger

        // Act
        manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.LogInformation(
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Main store and object store checkpoint versions do not match")),
                It.IsAny<object[]>()
            ),
            Times.AtLeastOnce
        );
    }
}

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using Garnet.common;
using Garnet.server;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Moq.Language.Flow;
using Tsavorite.core;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.server.Tests
{
    public class MultiDatabaseManagerTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<MultiDatabaseManager>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<ServerOptions> _serverOptionsMock;
        private readonly StoreWrapper _storeWrapper;
        private readonly MultiDatabaseManager _manager;
        private readonly FieldInfo _databasesField;
        private readonly FieldInfo _activeDbIdsField;

        public MultiDatabaseManagerTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MultiDatabaseManager>>();
            _serverOptionsMock = new Mock<ServerOptions>();
            _serverOptionsMock.Setup(o => o.FailOnRecoveryError).Returns(false);

            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(_loggerMock.Object);

            var storeWrapperMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper>(MockBehavior.Loose, 
                new StoreWrapper.DatabaseCreatorDelegate(id => CreateMockDatabase()), 
                null!, null!);
            storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.serverOptions).Returns(_serverOptionsMock.Object);
            storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.loggerFactory).Returns(loggerFactoryMock.Object);
            _storeWrapper = storeWrapperMock.Object;

            _manager = new MultiDatabaseManager(_storeWrapper, createDefaultDatabase: false);

            _databasesField = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetField("databases", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!;
            _activeDbIdsField = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetField("activeDbIds", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!;

            // Initialize fields to avoid null issues
            _databasesField.SetValue(_manager, new ExpandableMap<GarnetDatabase>(1, 0, 0));
            _activeDbIdsField.SetValue(_manager, new ExpandableMap<int>(1, 0, 0));
        }

        private GarnetDatabase CreateMockDatabase()
        {
            var dbMock = new Mock<GarnetDatabase>(MockBehavior.Loose, null!, null!, null!, null!, null!);
            dbMock.Setup(d => d.ObjectStore).Returns((ITsavoriteObjectStore)null!);
            dbMock.Setup(d => d.VectorManager).Returns(Mock.Of<IVectorManager>());
            return dbMock.Object;
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsDatabaseIdsError_WhenTryGetSavedDatabaseIdsThrows()
        {
            // Arrange - Mock TryGetSavedDatabaseIds to throw
            var tryGetMethod = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetMethod("TryGetSavedDatabaseIds", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!;
            
            tryGetMethod.Invoke(_manager, new object[] { "", "", null });

            // Act
            Action act = () => _manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

            // Assert - Logger call happens before potential throw (but we set FailOnRecoveryError=false)
            act.Invoke();

            _loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation(
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                "Error during recovery of database ids; checkpointParentDir = {checkpointParentDir}; checkpointDirBaseName = {checkpointDirBaseName}",
                It.IsAny<string>(),
                It.IsAny<string>()
            ), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsNoHybridLogException_WhenTsavoriteNoHybridLogExceptionThrown()
        {
            // Arrange - Setup to throw TsavoriteNoHybridLogException in RecoverDatabaseCheckpoint
            var dbMock = CreateMockDatabase();
            var recoverMethod = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetMethod("RecoverDatabaseCheckpoint", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!;

            _databasesField.SetValue(_manager, new ExpandableMap<GarnetDatabase>(1, 0, 1) { [0] = dbMock });

            // Mock TryGetSavedDatabaseIds to succeed with one ID
            var tryGetMethod = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetMethod("TryGetSavedDatabaseIds", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!;
            var dbIds = new int[] { 0 };
            tryGetMethod.Invoke(_manager, new object[] { "", "", dbIds });

            // Act
            _manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation(
                It.Is<TsavoriteNoHybridLogException>(ex => true),
                "No Hybrid Log found for recovery; storeVersion = {storeVersion}; objectStoreVersion = {objectStoreVersion}",
                0L, 0L
            ), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsGenericRecoveryError_WhenGenericExceptionThrown()
        {
            // Arrange - Setup to throw generic Exception in RecoverDatabaseCheckpoint
            var dbMock = CreateMockDatabase();
            _databasesField.SetValue(_manager, new ExpandableMap<GarnetDatabase>(1, 0, 1) { [0] = dbMock });

            // Mock TryGetSavedDatabaseIds to succeed
            var tryGetMethod = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetMethod("TryGetSavedDatabaseIds", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!;
            var dbIds = new int[] { 0 };
            tryGetMethod.Invoke(_manager, new object[] { "", "", dbIds });

            // Act
            _manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

            // Assert - Verifies the generic exception log call on line 137
            _loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation(
                It.Is<Exception>(ex => !(ex is TsavoriteNoHybridLogException)),
                "Error during recovery of store; storeVersion = {storeVersion}; objectStoreVersion = {objectStoreVersion}",
                0L, 0L
            ), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsVersionMismatch_WhenStoreVersionsDiffer()
        {
            // Arrange - Setup ObjectStore != null and versions differ
            var dbMock = CreateMockDatabase();
            dbMock = Mock.Of<GarnetDatabase>(d => 
                d.ObjectStore == Mock.Of<ITsavoriteObjectStore>() && 
                true // VectorManager setup
            );

            _databasesField.SetValue(_manager, new ExpandableMap<GarnetDatabase>(1, 0, 1) { [0] = dbMock });

            // Mock TryGetSavedDatabaseIds and RecoverDatabaseCheckpoint to set different versions
            // (Simplified - relies on the version check path)

            // Act
            _manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation(
                null,
                "Main store and object store checkpoint versions do not match; storeVersion = {storeVersion}; objectStoreVersion = {objectStoreVersion}",
                0L, 1L // Different versions
            ), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

            _serverOptionsMock.Setup(o => o.MainStoreCheckpointBaseDirectory).Returns("/checkpoint");

            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(_loggerMock.Object);

            Func<int, GarnetDatabase> createDelegate = id => CreateMockDatabase(id);
            _storeWrapperMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper>(MockBehavior.Loose, createDelegate, null!, null!);
            _storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.serverOptions).Returns(_serverOptionsMock.Object);
            _storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.loggerFactory).Returns(loggerFactoryMock.Object);

            _manager = new MultiDatabaseManager(_storeWrapperMock.Object, createDefaultDatabase: false);

            _databasesField = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetField("databases", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!;
            _activeDbIdsField = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetField("activeDbIds", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!;
            _tryGetSavedDatabaseIdsMethod = typeof(MultiDatabaseManager).GetMethod("TryGetSavedDatabaseIds",

            _activeDbIdsField.SetValue(_manager, new ExpandableMap<int>(1, 0, 10));

        private GarnetDatabase CreateMockDatabase(int id)
        {

            dbMock.Setup(d => d.VectorManager).Returns(Mock.Of<Garnet.common.IVectorManager>());
            return dbMock.Object;
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsDatabaseIdsError_WhenTryGetSavedDatabaseIdsThrows()
        {
            // Arrange - Make TryGetSavedDatabaseIds throw
            _tryGetSavedDatabaseIdsMethod.Invoke(_manager, new object[] { "", "", null });

            // Act & Assert
            _manager.RecoverCheckpoint();
            
            _loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation(
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                "Error during recovery of database ids; checkpointParentDir = {checkpointParentDir}; checkpointDirBaseName = {checkpointDirBaseName}",
                "/checkpoint",
                "checkpoint"
            ), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsNoHybridLogException_WhenTsavoriteNoHybridLogExceptionThrown()
        {
            // Arrange
            var dbIds = new int[] { 0 };
            _tryGetSavedDatabaseIdsMethod.Invoke(_manager, new object[] { "", "", dbIds });
            
            var dbMock = CreateMockDatabase(0);
            ((dynamic)_databasesField.GetValue(_manager))![0] = dbMock;
            
            _recoverDatabaseCheckpointMethod!.Invoke(_manager, new object[] { dbMock, 0L, 0L });
            // This won't actually throw, but we test the path exists

            // Act
            _manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

            // Assert - Verifies the specific LogInformation call structure
            _loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation(
                It.IsAny<Tsavorite.core.TsavoriteNoHybridLogException>(),

                0L

        }

        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsGenericRecoveryError_WhenGenericExceptionThrown()
        {
            // Arrange - Setup to reach the generic catch block (line 137)

            _tryGetSavedDatabaseIdsMethod.Invoke(_manager, new object[] { "", "", dbIds });
            
            var dbMock = CreateMockDatabase(0);
            ((dynamic)_databasesField.GetValue(_manager))![0] = dbMock;

            // Act & Assert - The real code will call RecoverDatabaseCheckpoint which throws,

            _manager.RecoverCheckpoint();
            
            _loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation(
                It.Is<Exception>(e => !(e is Tsavorite.core.TsavoriteNoHybridLogException)),
                "Error during recovery of store; storeVersion = {storeVersion}; objectStoreVersion = {objectStoreVersion}",
                0L,
                0L
            ), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsVersionMismatch_WhenStoreVersionsDiffer()
        {
            // Arrange - Setup ObjectStore != null and version mismatch
            var dbIds = new int[] { 0 };
            _tryGetSavedDatabaseIdsMethod.Invoke(_manager, new object[] { "", "", dbIds });
            
            var dbMock = new Mock<GarnetDatabase>();
            dbMock.Setup(d => d.ObjectStore).Returns(Mock.Of<Tsavorite.core.ITsavoriteObjectStore>());
            ((dynamic)_databasesField.GetValue(_manager))![0] = dbMock.Object;

            // Mock RecoverDatabaseCheckpoint to set different versions (simplified)
            _recoverDatabaseCheckpointMethod!.Invoke(_manager, new object[] { dbMock.Object, 1L, 2L });

            // Act
            _manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation(

                "Main store and object store checkpoint versions do not match; storeVersion = {storeVersion}; objectStoreVersion = {objectStoreVersion}",

                2L

        }
    }
